To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have proposed a new split two-Higgs-double model with the Higgs sector consisting of five physical scalars: a cosmic dark-energy scalar h with mass 10(-2)-10(-3)eV, a Standard Model-like Higgs boson H, and three exotic scalars A(0), H-+/- with masses at the weak scale, which are responsible for giving masses for all fermions except the neutrinos.
the two-Higgs model with a very small vev for one of its two doublets can be a candidate for the dark energy model and that this possibility may arise from neutrino condensates.

we have a model for the cosmic dark-energy and neutrino masses without introducing the see- saw mechanism; and that we have identified the origin of the second Higgs doublet from neutrino condensations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a dynamical model to explain the tiny neutrino masses, the dark-energy problem, and the origin of the doublet Phi (2).
a new physics scenario for the dark energy, neutrino mass, Higgs boson and exotic scalars at future colliders.
a possible dynamical mechanism to explain the tiny neutrino mass, the cosmic dark energy and the origin of two-Higgs-doublets in the framework of split two-Higgs-double models.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the split two-Higgs-double model is the simplest model for explaining the cosmic acceleration, the tiny neutrino mass, the Higgs boson mass and the existence of the exotic Higgs bosons at colliders.
the split two-Higgs-double model is the most promising candidate for the Standard Model extension that can accommodate the dark matter, dark energy and neutrino masses.
we are living in a universe with a cosmic-dark-energy field, a Standard Model Higgs, and exotic scalars, which can be dynamically generated through neutrino condensation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have proposed a new mechanism for generating neutrino mass without see-saw mechanism, a new mechanism for giving rise to cosmic dark energy and a new mechanism for the origin of the second Higgs doublet.
the split two-Higgs-doublets model with the neutrino condensation can be a natural and economical solution to the dark energy, the neutrino masses and the scalar sector of the Standard Model.
neutrino condensation can be the origin of neutrino masses, dark energy and the split of the two-Higgs doublets in a unified manner.
The main takeaway from our work is that
neutrino mass scale is the key to understanding the nature of dark energy and the origin of dark energy is related to the origin of neutrino mass.
the split two-Higgs-double model can be the simplest extension of the Standard Model with the right ingredients for explaining the origin of neutrino mass, dark energy and dark matter.
neutrino condensation may lead to a natural split two-Higgs-doublets model.
